learning_outcomes.text: Students will gain knowledge in theoretical electrotechnics and electrical measurement of electrical and non-electrical quantities.

syllabus_topics: Voltage- and current sources, resistors, capacitors, inductive coils
Alternative current circuits: analyses, resonances, powers
Structure diagrams and metrological characterizations of measuring devices
Electrical measurement of electrical and non-electrical quantities
assessment_rules: Students can get up to 5 points for their presentation during the lectures, 10 points for their work in the laboratory, 5 points for their essays, and up to 40 points for each of the two tests. The total number of points (maximum 100) is converted into a 6-grade evaluation scale. For a supplementary examination, points from the semester performance are not valid.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Industrial Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
